answer_1.quote: LLM-based agents capable of reasoning, using tools, and engaging in user interactions are becoming increasingly central to AI-driven applications across a wide range of domains, including customer service, healthcare, financial services and banking, child facing education and legal support.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs involve multi-turn dialogue interactions between user simulators and policy-adherent agents, including responses to user requests, tool calls, and policy-compliant decision-making in customer service scenarios.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate agent safety in stochasticity, we use the pass@k metric, which measures the probability that at least one of the k randomly selected trials results in a successful attack.
